FIELDS.NAME: Luminous Lighting Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Luminous Lighting Solutions specializes in the retail sale of high-quality lighting fixtures and supplies. Our operations are centered around providing a wide range of products, including LED bulbs, chandeliers, sconces, and other lighting accessories. We primarily conduct sales through our well-organized physical storefront, allowing customers to experience our products firsthand. We also maintain an online presence; however, no more than 75% of our total revenue is generated from online sales, which helps mitigate shipping losses and cyber risks. While we do offer minimal on-site installation services, they comprise less than 10% of our overall revenue, aligning with our focus on retail sales. Our team is knowledgeable and committed to providing exceptional customer service, ensuring that customers find the right lighting solutions for their needs. We adhere to all safety standards, including those set by UL and ANSI, confirming that our products are safe and meet industry regulations. Inventory is secured in monitored facilities, and we implement regular inventory management controls to prevent loss.

Our business specializes in selling lighting fixtures and supplies, and we also provide on-site installation and repair services, which account for a significant portion of our operations, as we aim to ensure our customers receive complete and satisfactory solutions for their lighting needs.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: "Minimal other businesses are owned, consisting of a small online store for lighting accessories, which generates less than 10% of total revenue."
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On-site installation services from 01/15/2020 to present resulted in a total loss of $5,000 due to unforeseen complications, currently under assessment.
